about.title: Engineer first. Partner always.
about.body: I'm Ahmad, an AI-focused Software Engineer and public speaker passionate about turning complex ideas into impactful technology. My work spans machine learning, LLM-powered applications, RAG, and modern web and mobile products. I work directly with clients — from the initial concept to the final product.
about.pageLead: I'm an AI-focused Software Engineer, technology enthusiast, and public speaker passionate about turning complex ideas into impactful technology.
about.story1: My journey began with hardware, robotics, and engineering projects, where I developed a systems-thinking mindset — understanding not only how technology works, but how it can solve real-world problems and create meaningful value.
about.story2: Today, my work centers on Artificial Intelligence and Software Engineering, spanning machine learning, LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the development of modern web and mobile products.
about.story3: Beyond engineering, I have been involved in the broader technology and academic community. I had the privilege of serving as a judge in a major Artificial Intelligence competition, evaluating innovation and emerging AI solutions. As a public speaker, I have delivered numerous speeches and talks at academic institutions and university communities, sharing ideas around technology, innovation, and the future of AI.
about.story4: I believe great technology requires more than technical expertise. It takes vision, critical thinking, and the ability to communicate ideas clearly and turn them into reality.
about.story5: I work directly with clients, combining technical execution with a clear understanding of business objectives — from the initial concept to the final product.
